description: A patient in the hospital can take two pills, Pill 1 and Pill 2. Per pill, pill 1 provides 0.2 units of pain medication and 0.3 units of anxiety medication. Per pill, pill 2 provides 0.6 units of pain medication and 0.2 units of anxiety medication. In addition, pill 1 causes 0.3 units of discharge while pill 2 causes 0.1 units of discharge. At most 6 units of pain medication can be provided and at least 3 units of anxiety medication must be provided. How many pills of each should the patient be given to minimize the total amount of discharge?

PainMedicationPerPill.definition: Amount of pain medication provided by one unit of each pill type

AnxietyMedicationPerPill.definition: Amount of anxiety medication provided by one unit of each pill type

DischargePerPill.definition: Amount of discharge caused by one unit of each pill type

MaxPainMedication.definition: Maximum units of pain medication allowed

MinAnxietyMedication.definition: Minimum units of anxiety medication required

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of discharge caused by the pills taken"

constraints.description: The total pain medication provided by all pills should not exceed MaxPainMedication
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(PainMedicationPerPill[i] * NumPills[i] for i in range(NumPillTypes))
    <= MaxPainMedication
)

constraints.description: The total anxiety medication provided by all pills should be at least MinAnxietyMedication
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(AnxietyMedicationPerPill[i] * NumPills[i] for i in range(NumPillTypes)) 
    >= MinAnxietyMedication
)

constraints.description: The number of pills taken of each type should be non-negative

NumPills.definition: Number of pills taken of each pill type
